overview: P1 Operational Validation — WAF Bypass via PayloadMutator on Target-05. Validates the full P1 chain: WAFDetector fingerprinting → Student candidate tagging → PayloadMutator mutation → CapabilityBroker authorization → successful bypass → flag capture.

waf_profile.detection_mechanism: Case-sensitive substring match on raw input

attack_scenarios.name: WAF Block — Direct SQLi
attack_scenarios.description: Direct SQLi with lowercase patterns is blocked by WAF. WAFDetector fingerprints the block response.

attack_scenarios.name: WAF Bypass — Case Variation
attack_scenarios.description: Case variation bypasses the case-sensitive WAF. PayloadMutator should generate this variant.

attack_scenarios.name: Flag Capture Validation
attack_scenarios.description: Successful bypass returns the flag in the response body.

attack_scenarios.name: Rate Limiter Active
attack_scenarios.description: RateLimiter applies jitter between repeat bypass attempts.

p1_components_validated.validation: Scope is set to 172.18.0.0/16 including localhost. Target-05 at localhost:8081 is in scope.
RateLimiter delays between mutation attempts. ShellKeepAlive sends \n during delay.
WAFDetector probes target-05, detects 403 with WAF signature in body.
p1_components_validated.expected: WAF type detected as 'unknown' or 'custom' with confidence > 0.6

p1_components_validated.validation: PayloadMutator generates case variation for 'union select' → 'UnIoN SeLeCt'.

expected_p1_flow: 1. Probe target-05 with '1' union select 1,2,3' → 403 (WAF blocks)
6. Student returns mutated Candidates to Planner
9. EvidenceExtractor captures flag → WorldModel stores as CREDENTIAL flag
safety_invariants: SI-P1-01: ScopeParser DENY if target ambiguous
SI-P1-02: RateLimiter never blocks emergency shutdown
SI-P1-03: WAF detection probes contain no exploit payloads
SI-P1-04: Max 3 mutation rounds per original payload
SI-P1-05: CapabilityBroker remains sole authorization authority
SI-P1-06: All stealth modules log every decision
SI-P1-07: Keepalive sends empty newline only
